title: Dedupe Key Picker
description: Stops a dedupe from merging nothing or merging too much by previewing, as you pick the columns that define a duplicate, how many rows would merge, naming the near-unique column (like a timestamp) that keeps duplicates apart with a one-tap "leave it out", flagging a key so broad one value swallows a quarter of the table, keeping blank keys separate and showing sample collisions with the values a merge would discard highlighted.
